summary: This directory serves as a centralized repository for defining the data validation and structure schemas for domain-specific business entities (gyomu), covering aspects such as task management, service definitions, scheduling configurations, and workflow milestones.
responsibilities: Defining CRUD operation schemas for core business entities
Establishing standardized data structures for status tracking and task execution
Enforcing schema validation rules for system configurations and parameter management
relationships: CRUD schemas define the required data shape for managing individual business entities. Each schema ensures that data interacting with system services and task handlers remains consistent. These entities collectively represent the business domain logic governing task scheduling and service monitoring.
designDecisions: Centralized schema definition for consistent data validation
Granular schema separation per business entity type
Exporting entity schemas through a unified index interface
